item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Sat 14:00): The Happy Pod: Fat Bear Week returns
item.description:
Originally published Sat 03 Oct 2026 14:00 IDT.

Fat Bear Week is back! The annual contest sees people around the world vote for their favourite bear, ahead of hibernation season. More than two million votes were cast this year's tournament which is based at Katmai National Park and Preserve in Alaska.

Also, meet the tattoo artist covering people's scars with artwork to make them feel more confident.

Cath Bowie, aka GrumpyGran 1948, tells us how she got into streaming and the game Fortnite. She's just been recognised by Guiness World Records as the world's oldest female Fortnite streamer at the age of 78.

Plus, 'Walk with a Doc', a scheme that gets people out walking with their local doctor and, have you ever heard an Elephant's rumble? We find out what it means.

Our weekly collection of inspiring, uplifting and happy news from around the world.

Image: Fat Bear Week winner, 'Backpack'. Credit: Katmai National Park and Preserve/Explore.org
